source: warcraft.wiki.gg quest pages, read 2026-10-30. CMaNGOS classic-db leaves these quests' reputation requirement empty, so it is taken from the wiki. The standing follows the slot the token makes, not the class: checked on the quests listed under sampled (warrior, druid, warlock, priest and mage turn-ins). Tokens whose own quests were not sampled (Bindings of Dominance, Skin of the Great Sandworm, Carapace of the Old God) are given their slot's standing. Wowhead's page for quest 8544 (Conqueror's Spaulders) also gives Neutral.
